chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Why Nazarro favored other acts over Buck and Bubbles
summary: Nazarro could book weaker acts like Heckle and Jive cheaply and sell them for more, claiming they were as good as Buck and Bubbles.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: He can get more money out of Heckle and Jive than he can out of Buck and Bubbles.
How so? He had a different arrangement with them?

Oh, man. Listen. He would book them for instance for $100, sell them for $350, understand, or $300, tell them they're a better act than Buck and Bubbles or as good as Buck and Bubbles you just haven't seen them that's all. Just that they've been out.
That's what he would do and that's what I know he would do. Okay? I learned him doing that. So what should happen, we do the "Carmen Jones" and everything --
